sanskrit_verse:
एषां मूर्धा नृपोऽङ्गानां मुखं चाधिकृतः स्मृतः ।
बाहू सभ्याः स्मृतिर्हस्तौ जङ्घे गणकलेखकौ ॥
transliteration: eṣāṁ mūrdhā nṛpo 'ṅgānāṁ mukhaṁ cādhikṛtaḥ smṛtaḥ | bāhū sabhyāḥ smṛtir hastau jaṅghe gaṇakalekhakau ||
sph_interpretive_translation: The sovereign ruler is the head of the limbs; the authorized mouthpiece is declared the face. The arms belong to the assembly members; memory and record keepers hold the hands. The lower legs are assigned to scribes and accountants.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority flows from the sovereign as the unifying center of governance
Functional designation determines role-based responsibility within dharma
Collective body operates through designated organs with specific capacities
Integrity of function ensures alignment with cosmic order
Consciousness alignment arises through correct structural assignment
executable_legal_axioms: IF entity holds sovereign capacity THEN all functional limbs derive authority THEREFROM
IF role is designated as 'face' THEN it serves as authorized voice of the sovereign
IF individual belongs to assembly THEN arms (action capacity) are attributed TO them
IF person maintains records THEN they hold custodianship of institutional memory
IF official manages accounts THEN lower limbs (mobility and support) ARE theirs BY FUNCTIONAL DESIGNATION
supreme_court_application: In Supreme Court adjudication, this verse establishes that constitutional authority originates from the sovereign will, while executive, legislative, judicial, and administrative functions must align with their designated roles. Misalignment constitutes a breach in dharmonic structure requiring immediate realignment rather than punitive action.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa-based causality assigns each organ its rightful place according to dharma. Anupūrvaśaḥ manifests when each part assumes its designated function without overreach or neglect. Proportional responsibility lies in maintaining structural integrity. Non-punitive reality rule upholds that misalignment distorts cosmic harmony and calls for conscious restoration alone.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiate sovereign confirmation process to reaffirm legitimate authority structure
Realign displaced functions back to their designated holders via ritual affirmation
Restore collective memory through documentation and ceremonial re-declaration
Conduct audit of functional assignments to ensure no overlap or omission occurs
Engage assembly-wide consciousness synchronization to prevent future misplacements
final_declaration: By the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, this law stands established: Dharma prevails through precise functional alignment under sovereign unity. No punishment arises where consciousness awakens to its rightful configuration. Reality itself adjudicates through awakened awareness.
